# API reference: SCNodePool

<!-- Generated by `make docs-api` from config/crd/bases; do not edit. -->

Every field of the `SCNodePool` custom resource, as the API server accepts it
(generated from the CRD). What the selector and ranking fields mean, which
Spare Cores data they read and how well vendors cover them is in the
[selector reference](selectors.md); how a spec becomes a NodePool is described in
[how to write an SCNodePool](../how-to-guides/write-an-scnodepool.md). The
controller's flags, conditions and metrics are in the
[controller reference](controller.md).

Units: memory is GiB (2^30 bytes) unless a field name says otherwise, prices are
USD per hour (decimal strings such as `"0.40"`), every other number is a plain
number.

## Resource

| | |
|---|---|
| apiVersion | `karpenter.sparecores.com/v1alpha1` |
| kind | `SCNodePool` |
| scope | Cluster |
| resource | `scnodepools` |
| subresources | `status` |
| printer columns | NodePool, Provider, Types, Ready, Last refresh, Age |

SCNodePool selects instance types from Spare Cores data and generates a Karpenter NodePool from them. Cluster-scoped; the generated NodePool has the same name.

## spec

### `spec`

spec defines the desired state of SCNodePool

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `churn` | [object](#specchurn) | `{}` | churn limits how fast instance types are removed from the NodePool (removing a type drifts every running node of that type). |
| `deletionPolicy` | string | `"Delete"` | deletionPolicy decides what happens to the NodePool when this object is deleted. One of `Delete`, `Orphan`. |
| `dryRun` | boolean | `false` | dryRun computes and reports the selection in status without ever creating or updating the NodePool. |
| `nodePoolTemplate` (required) | [object](#specnodepooltemplate) |  | nodePoolTemplate is the template of the generated Karpenter NodePool. |
| `ranking` | [object](#specranking) |  | ranking keeps only the best families of the candidates that passed the selector. Without ranking, every candidate is emitted. |
| `refresh` | [object](#specrefresh) | `{}` | refresh controls how often the selection is re-evaluated. |
| `selector` | [object](#specselector) |  | selector filters the Spare Cores candidates. All fields are optional; without a selector every candidate that passes the provider's eligibility filter is emitted. |

### `spec.churn`

churn limits how fast instance types are removed from the NodePool (removing a type drifts every running node of that type).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `maxRemovalsPerRefresh` | integer (int32) | `3` | maxRemovalsPerRefresh caps the removals of one refresh (types the provider no longer offers are exempt). Minimum 0. |
| `removeAfterRefreshes` | integer (int32) | `2` | removeAfterRefreshes: the number of consecutive refreshes a type must fail before it is removed. Minimum 0. |
| `removeMarginPercent` | number | `5` | removeMarginPercent: a type is removed only if it fails the selection by more than this percentage of the failing threshold (or is no longer offered at all). Minimum 0. |

### `spec.nodePoolTemplate`

nodePoolTemplate is the template of the generated Karpenter NodePool.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `metadata` | [object](#specnodepooltemplatemetadata) |  | metadata holds the labels and annotations of the NodePool object (not of the nodes). |
| `spec` (required) | object (free-form) |  | spec is a karpenter.sh/v1 NodePoolSpec, verbatim. It is deliberately untyped so that every provider's NodePool schema version is accepted (for example EKS Auto Mode adds fields and enum values). The controller validates it at runtime with a server-side dry run against the cluster's NodePool CRD. template.spec.nodeClassRef is required and selects the provider adapter. |

### `spec.nodePoolTemplate.metadata`

metadata holds the labels and annotations of the NodePool object (not of the nodes).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `annotations` | map of string values |  |  |
| `labels` | map of string values |  |  |

### `spec.ranking`

ranking keeps only the best families of the candidates that passed the selector. Without ranking, every candidate is emitted.

Semantics: [selectors reference](selectors.md).

Validation: ranking needs band or families.max (`has(self.band) \|\| (has(self.families) && has(self.families.max))`).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `band` | [object](#specrankingband) |  | band keeps the families whose objective is within a percentage of the best family's. |
| `families` | [object](#specrankingfamilies) |  | families bounds the number of kept families. |
| `normalize` | string | `"None"` | normalize is applied to the score before the objective. One of `None`, `PerVcpu`. |
| `objective` | string | `"Score"` | objective is what the ranking optimises. One of `Score`, `ScorePerPrice`, `Price`. |
| `score` (required) | [object](#specrankingscore) |  | score is what to rank by. |

### `spec.ranking.band`

band keeps the families whose objective is within a percentage of the best family's.

Semantics: [selectors reference](selectors.md).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `withinPercent` (required) | number |  | withinPercent: keep families within this percentage of the best. Minimum 0. Maximum 100. |

### `spec.ranking.families`

families bounds the number of kept families.

Semantics: [selectors reference](selectors.md).

Validation: min must not exceed max (`!has(self.min) \|\| !has(self.max) \|\| self.min <= self.max`).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `max` | integer (int32) |  | max keeps at most this many families, even if more are inside the band. Minimum 1. |
| `min` | integer (int32) | `1` | min widens the band until at least this many families are kept (the capacity floor). Minimum 1. |

### `spec.ranking.score`

score is what to rank by.

Semantics: [selectors reference](selectors.md).

Validation: set exactly one of benchmark and workloadProfile (`has(self.benchmark) != has(self.workloadProfile)`).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `benchmark` | [object](#specrankingscorebenchmark) |  | BenchmarkRef identifies one Spare Cores benchmark. |
| `workloadProfile` | string |  | WorkloadProfileName is one of the Spare Cores compound workload benchmarks. One of `web`, `compute`, `cache`, `data_analysis`, `llm`, `cicd`. |

### `spec.ranking.score.benchmark`

BenchmarkRef identifies one Spare Cores benchmark.

Semantics: [selectors reference](selectors.md).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `config` | object (free-form) |  | config is a JSON object. Required when the benchmark has more than one config; validated against Keeper's benchmark_configs by comparing parsed objects. |
| `id` (required) | string |  | id is a benchmark_id, for example geekbench:score. At most 128 characters. |

### `spec.refresh`

refresh controls how often the selection is re-evaluated.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `interval` | string | `"24h"` | interval is the re-evaluation period, at least one hour. Spec changes re-evaluate immediately, as does a new value of the annotation karpenter.sparecores.com/refresh-requested. At most 32 characters. Pattern `^([0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?(ns\|us\|µs\|ms\|s\|m\|h))+$`. Rule: refresh.interval must be at least 1h (`duration(self) >= duration('1h')`). |

### `spec.selector`

selector filters the Spare Cores candidates. All fields are optional; without a selector every candidate that passes the provider's eligibility filter is emitted.

Semantics: [selectors reference](selectors.md).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `accelerator` | [object](#specselectoraccelerator) |  | AcceleratorSelector selects on GPUs and TPUs (Spare Cores "accelerators"). |
| `architectures` | array of string |  | architectures restricts the CPU architecture; intersected with a kubernetes.io/arch requirement of the template. One of `amd64`, `arm64`. At most 2 items. |
| `benchmarks` | array of [object](#specselectorbenchmarks) |  | benchmarks are filters on benchmark scores; entries are AND-ed. At most 32 items. |
| `cpu` | [object](#specselectorcpu) |  | CPUSelector selects on CPU facts. |
| `families` | [object](#specselectorfamilies) |  | families include/exclude globs on the Spare Cores family string. |
| `instanceTypes` | [object](#specselectorinstancetypes) |  | instanceTypes include/exclude globs on the instance type name (server.api_reference). |
| `memory` | [object](#specselectormemory) |  | MemorySelector selects on memory size, in GiB. |
| `network` | [object](#specselectornetwork) |  | NetworkSelector selects on network bandwidth. Setting a field excludes every type without a value. |
| `price` | [object](#specselectorprice) |  | PriceSelector selects on the hourly price in USD. |
| `storage` | [object](#specselectorstorage) |  | StorageSelector selects on instance-local storage. |
| `unbenchmarked` | string | `"Exclude"` | unbenchmarked decides what happens to candidates that lack a score needed by a benchmark filter, workload profile or the ranking score. One of `Exclude`, `IncludeIfFamilyQualifies`, `Include`. |
| `vcpus` | [object](#specselectorvcpus) |  | vcpus are inclusive bounds on the vCPU count. |
| `workloadProfiles` | array of [object](#specselectorworkloadprofiles) |  | workloadProfiles are filters on the compound workload benchmarks; entries are AND-ed with the benchmarks. At most 8 items. |

### `spec.selector.accelerator`

AcceleratorSelector selects on GPUs and TPUs (Spare Cores "accelerators").

Semantics: [selectors reference](selectors.md).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `count` | [object](#specselectoracceleratorcount) |  | count is inclusive and may be fractional (vGPU slices). max: 0 selects servers without any accelerator. |
| `manufacturers` | array of string |  | manufacturers are Spare Cores values (NVIDIA, AMD, Habana, Google, ...). At most 16 items. At most 64 characters. |
| `memoryPerDevice` | [object](#specselectoracceleratormemoryperdevice) |  | memoryPerDevice: memory of the smallest accelerator, lower bound. |
| `memoryTotal` | [object](#specselectoracceleratormemorytotal) |  | memoryTotal: memory summed over all accelerators, lower bound. |
| `models` | array of string |  | models are exact Spare Cores model strings (L40S, A10G, ...); they are not normalised across vendors. At most 64 items. At most 64 characters. |
| `types` | array of string |  | types restricts the type of the primary accelerator. Unknown types are excluded when this is set. One of `GPU`, `TPU`. At most 2 items. |

### `spec.selector.accelerator.count`

count is inclusive and may be fractional (vGPU slices). max: 0 selects servers without any accelerator.

Semantics: [selectors reference](selectors.md).

Validation: min must not exceed max (`!has(self.min) \|\| !has(self.max) \|\| self.min <= self.max`).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `max` | number |  | Minimum 0. |
| `min` | number |  | Minimum 0. |

memoryPerDevice: memory of the smallest accelerator, lower bound.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `minGiB` | number |  | Minimum 0. |

### `spec.selector.accelerator.memoryTotal`

memoryTotal: memory summed over all accelerators, lower bound.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|

### `spec.selector.benchmarks[]`

BenchmarkFilter is one filter on a benchmark score.

Semantics: [selectors reference](selectors.md).

Validation: a benchmark entry needs min or max (`has(self.min) \|\| has(self.max)`).

Validation: min must not exceed max (`!has(self.min) \|\| !has(self.max) \|\| self.min <= self.max`).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `config` | object (free-form) |  | config is a JSON object. Required when the benchmark has more than one config; validated against Keeper's benchmark_configs by comparing parsed objects. |
| `id` (required) | string |  | id is a benchmark_id, for example geekbench:score. At most 128 characters. |
| `max` | number |  | max is an inclusive upper bound, for lower-is-better benchmarks (latencies). |
| `min` | number |  | min is an inclusive lower bound on the (normalised) score, for higher-is-better benchmarks. |
| `normalize` | string | `"None"` | normalize selects the score normalisation. One of `None`, `PerVcpu`, `PerPrice`. |

### `spec.selector.cpu`

CPUSelector selects on CPU facts.

Semantics: [selectors reference](selectors.md).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `allocations` | array of string |  | allocations restricts the CPU allocation class. One of `Shared`, `Burstable`, `Dedicated`. At most 3 items. |
| `caches` | [object](#specselectorcpucaches) |  | caches filters on cache sizes (lower bounds only). |
| `clockSpeedMinGHz` | number |  | clockSpeedMinGHz is a lower bound on the vendor-reported clock speed. Minimum 0. |
| `flags` | [object](#specselectorcpuflags) |  | flags filters on Linux /proc/cpuinfo flag names, lowercase. |
| `hyperthreading` | boolean |  | hyperthreading true selects types with more vCPUs than physical cores (SMT siblings), false selects one vCPU per physical core. Unset: no filter. |
| `manufacturers` | array of string |  | manufacturers are exact, case-sensitive Spare Cores values (Intel, AMD, AWS, Ampere, Alibaba, Microsoft, Hygon). At most 16 items. At most 64 characters. |

NetworkSelector selects on network bandwidth. Setting a field excludes every type without a value.

Semantics: [selectors reference](selectors.md).

|---|---|---|---|
| `baselineMinGbps` | number |  | baselineMinGbps is a lower bound on the guaranteed bandwidth. Minimum 0. |

### `spec.selector.price`

PriceSelector selects on the hourly price in USD.

Semantics: [selectors reference](selectors.md).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `basis` | string |  | basis is the price allocation. Default: Spot if the template's karpenter.sh/capacity-type requirement allows only spot, otherwise OnDemand. One of `OnDemand`, `Spot`. |
| `includeManagedFee` | boolean |  | includeManagedFee adds the EKS Auto Mode management fee to prices before filtering and ranking. Defaults to true on Auto Mode and is ignored elsewhere. |
| `maxHourly` | string |  | maxHourly is an inclusive upper bound on the hourly price of the type in USD, as a decimal string (for example "0.40"). It also caps the node size. At most 16 characters. Pattern `^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$`. |
| `maxHourlyPerVcpu` | string |  | maxHourlyPerVcpu is an inclusive upper bound on the hourly price per vCPU in USD, as a decimal string. At most 16 characters. Pattern `^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$`. |

LocalStorageSelector selects on the disks bundled with the instance type.

| `minGB` | number |  | minGB is a lower bound on the total local disk size in GB. Minimum 0. |

### `spec.selector.workloadProfiles[]`

WorkloadProfileFilter is a filter on workload_profile:<name>. Scores are unitless; 1.0 is the fleet-median server.

Semantics: [selectors reference](selectors.md).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `min` (required) | number |  | min is an inclusive lower bound on the (normalised) score. Minimum 0. |
| `name` (required) | string |  | WorkloadProfileName is one of the Spare Cores compound workload benchmarks. One of `web`, `compute`, `cache`, `data_analysis`, `llm`, `cicd`. |
| `normalize` | string | `"None"` | normalize selects the score normalisation. One of `None`, `PerVcpu`, `PerPrice`. |

## status

### `status`

status defines the observed state of SCNodePool

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `conditions` | array of [object](#statusconditions) |  | conditions: Ready, DataAvailable, SelectionNonEmpty, NodePoolSynced, NodePoolManaged, NodePoolValid, NodePoolSchedulable, RegionConflict. |
| `dataTimestamp` | string (date-time) |  | dataTimestamp is the freshness of the Keeper data used. |
| `excluded` | [object](#statusexcluded) |  | excluded counts the candidates dropped by each pipeline step. |
| `lastRefreshTime` | string (date-time) |  | lastRefreshTime is when the selection was last evaluated. |
| `nodePoolName` | string |  | nodePoolName is the name of the generated NodePool. |
| `observedGeneration` | integer (int64) |  | observedGeneration is the metadata.generation the controller last processed. |
| `pendingRemovals` | array of [object](#statuspendingremovals) |  | pendingRemovals are types that no longer qualify but are kept until the churn control lets them go. |
| `provider` | string |  | provider is the id of the provider adapter chosen from the nodeClassRef. |
| `regionSource` | string |  | regionSource tells where the regions were detected. One of `NodeClass`, `NodeLabels`. |
| `regions` | array of string |  | regions are the detected Kubernetes region values. |
| `selected` | [object](#statusselected) |  | selected describes the current selection. |

### `status.conditions[]`

Condition contains details for one aspect of the current state of this API Resource.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `lastTransitionTime` (required) | string (date-time) |  | lastTransitionTime is the last time the condition transitioned from one status to another. This should be when the underlying condition changed. If that is not known, then using the time when the API field changed is acceptable. |
| `message` (required) | string |  | message is a human readable message indicating details about the transition. This may be an empty string. At most 32768 characters. |
| `observedGeneration` | integer (int64) |  | observedGeneration represents the .metadata.generation that the condition was set based upon. For instance, if .metadata.generation is currently 12, but the .status.conditions[x].observedGeneration is 9, the condition is out of date with respect to the current state of the instance. Minimum 0. |
| `reason` (required) | string |  | reason contains a programmatic identifier indicating the reason for the condition's last transition. Producers of specific condition types may define expected values and meanings for this field, and whether the values are considered a guaranteed API. The value should be a CamelCase string. This field may not be empty. At most 1024 characters. Pattern `^[A-Za-z]([A-Za-z0-9_,:]*[A-Za-z0-9_])?$`. |
| `status` (required) | string |  | status of the condition, one of True, False, Unknown. One of `True`, `False`, `Unknown`. |
| `type` (required) | string |  | type of condition in CamelCase or in foo.example.com/CamelCase. At most 316 characters. Pattern `^([a-z0-9]([-a-z0-9]*[a-z0-9])?(\.[a-z0-9]([-a-z0-9]*[a-z0-9])?)*/)?(([A-Za-z0-9][-A-Za-z0-9_.]*)?[A-Za-z0-9])$`. |
